login.description: Access your resident dashboard to track local hazard reports, interact with community engineering teams, and stay updated with the latest city infrastructure news.

hero.subtitle: A public platform helping citizens report infrastructure hazards in real-time. Powering a faster, safer, and more responsive Caloocan North through technology.

features.title: Optimized for the Community
features.subtitle: A specialized platform empowering Caloocan North residents to actively participate in infrastructure maintenance and safety monitoring.
features.f1_desc: Precise mapping of reports to pinpoint infrastructure issues across the city.
features.f2_desc: Integrated human and AI verification ensuring every report is legitimate and prioritized.
features.f3_desc: Continuous infrastructure monitoring to identify issues before they become major failures.

solutions.title: Targeted Responses for Critical Infrastructure.
solutions.subtitle: PULSO categorizes reports automatically, routing specific hazards to specialized engineering teams instantly.
solutions.s1_desc: Pothole patching, sidewalk repairs, and structural monitoring for city and barangay road networks.
solutions.s2_desc: Cleaning of clogged canals, manhole maintenance, and flood control for the city's drainage system.
solutions.s3_desc: Installation and repair of streetlights, electrical wiring, and lamp posts to ensure nighttime safety.
solutions.s4_desc: Building inspections, disaster debris clearing, and safety compliance for city infrastructure.
solutions.s5_desc: Maintenance of public schools, health centers, recreational plazas, and city-owned buildings.

about.title: A Modern Governance Initiative.
about.p1: The City Government of Caloocan launched the PULSO Project to bridge the gap between citizens and engineering operations. By crowdsourcing infrastructure data, we transform every smartphone into a vital city sensor.
about.p2: Moving away from archaic, paper-based reporting, Caloocan North is embracing proactive, data-driven governance. Our goal is not just to fix problems faster, but to predict and prevent them entirely.
about.analytics_desc: Real-time resolution metrics strictly monitored by the LGU.

howitworks.title: Report an Issue in 5 Simple Steps.
howitworks.subtitle: PULSO optimizes the entire process from citizen report to verified resolution — powered by AI triage and real-time response.
howitworks.s1_desc: Create your resident account and verify your residency with a government-issued ID. Only verified Caloocan North residents can submit reports.
howitworks.s2_desc: Take a clear photo of the infrastructure hazard on-site. Your GPS coordinates are automatically tagged for pinpoint accuracy.
howitworks.s3_desc: Gemini AI instantly analyzes your photo and description, categorizes the issue, assigns an urgency score, and generates a ticket.
howitworks.s4_desc: A city official reviews the AI-verified ticket, confirms priority, and assigns the nearest qualified field crew.
howitworks.s5_desc: Field crews complete the repair and upload Proof of Repair photos. You get notified once your report is marked resolved.

services.title: Access Caloocan City Services Online.
services.subtitle: Beyond infrastructure reporting, Caloocan City offers these digital services for residents. Powered by the City Services Portal.
services.senior_desc: Register for your official PVC ID card to access senior citizen benefits and services under OSCA.
services.pwd_desc: Register for your official PVC ID card to access PWD benefits and services from the city government.
services.solo_desc: Register for your Solo Parent ID card to access benefits and services under RA 8972 (Solo Parents Welfare Act).
services.gad_desc: For barangays: Submit and track your Gender and Development Plan, Budget, and Accomplishment Reports.

help.assistDesc: Our support team is available during standard operating hours to assist with application issues.
help.hotlinesDesc: For immediate life-threatening infrastructure failures, bypass the app and call these numbers directly.
help.q1: How long does it take for a report to be verified?
help.a1: Most priority reports submitted with clear GPS and photo evidence are reviewed by the engineering AI within 15 minutes. Manual review may take up to 2 hours.
help.a2: Your Trust Score increases as you submit accurate, high-quality reports that get verified and resolved. Higher scores grant your future reports priority routing.
help.q3: Can I report issues outside my registered barangay?
help.a3: Yes. While your home base is pinned to your profile, the Quick Report tool uses your live phone GPS to tag the exact coordinate of the hazard, regardless of where you are in the city.
